## 4.

## 5.


Consider a house as an example of a *system*. Make a list of five or more familiar dimensions of a house.

Similarly, imagine a data frame storing measured information about each of the houses on a block.

Write a meaningful paragraph describing the relationship between your list of dimensions for a single house and the data frame of many houses.  In your paragraph, use each of these words properly in its technical sense: object type, operationalization, variable, specimen, value
